la-flor-dominicana--double-ligero.description: Litto Gomez's Double Ligero packs estate-grown Dominican filler and binder, heavy in ligero, under a dark, sun-grown Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, and every size comes in natural or maduro. Full in strength, the natural leans to leather, spice, coffee bean and smoky wood, while the maduro adds espresso, earth, black pepper and dark cherry.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Double Ligero
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Double Ligero
Cigar Inspector – La Flor Dominicana Double Ligero Natural review
He Spoke Style – La Flor Dominicana Double Ligero review

thirds.notes: In the natural Chisel, an aggressive wave of pepper and spice over wood, with chocolate, dried fruit and a citrus hint beneath.
The spice calms somewhat, black pepper and cinnamon remain, and cocoa, sweet wood, dried fruit and leather come through.
Spice returns in force with wood and leather and a charred, meaty note, as the nicotine peaks.

la-flor-dominicana--ligero.description: La Flor Dominicana's first full-bodied blend, made after years of ageing the farm's own ligero, with Dominican filler and binder under an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper; the #400 also comes in a darker oscuro leaf. The natural shows leather, cedar and nuts with pepper and a floral touch, while the oscuro turns to pepper, espresso and raisin.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Ligero
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Ligero
The Cigar Authority – La Flor Dominicana L300 Oscuro review
Holt's Clubhouse – La Flor Dominicana Ligero Oscuro L-300 review

thirds.notes: In the #300 Oscuro, sharp spice and black pepper open, with earth, cedar and charred wood, cocoa, espresso and a hint of raisin.
Earthy spice takes over, balanced by a steady sweetness, with leather, cedar and a warm chocolate aroma.
The strongest third: pepper and cedar with raisin, mesquite-like smoke and a dark coffee finish.

la-flor-dominicana--colorado-oscuro.description: Colorado Oscuro brings the Dominican Republic and Nicaragua together: a dark Nicaraguan Habano wrapper over a Dominican binder and a filler of Dominican and Nicaraguan tobacco. Made by La Flor Dominicana in the Dominican Republic and offered in two sizes, it is a full-bodied cigar with a dense, concentrated burst of flavour.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Colorado Oscuro
Cigar Obsession – La Flor Dominicana Colorado Oscuro No. 4 review

thirds.notes: In the No. 4, light cocoa and coffee with sweet cream lead into a deep, earthy finish.
The cocoa and most of the sweetness fall away, and the earthy finish becomes lighter.
The flavours stay consistent to the nub while the strength builds slowly from the band onward.

la-flor-dominicana--air-bender.description: Air Bender wraps La Flor Dominicana's estate-grown Dominican filler and binder in a Cuban-seed Habano wrapper grown in Ecuador, made here in the brand's signature Chisel shape. Medium-full to full, it is peppery and savoury, with leather, a smoky mesquite-like wood and licorice in a smooth, refined smoke.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Air Bender
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Air Bender
Kohnhed (Katman) – La Flor Dominicana Air Bender review

thirds.notes: In the corona, red pepper, rich earth, sweet tobacco and wood build steadily from a gentle start.
Creaminess lifts the sweetness as red pepper ramps up and cocoa appears over deep earth.
Cocoa comes forward with a syrupy sweetness, smooth cream and a long spicy finish, as the strength eases.

la-flor-dominicana--air-bender-maduro.description: The maduro version of Air Bender uses a darker, thicker and oilier Ecuadorian Habano wrapper over estate-grown Dominican long filler, made in La Flor Dominicana's signature Chisel shape. Medium to full, it mixes earth, black pepper and cocoa with woody notes before a charred, smoky finish; a cigar for the evening.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Air Bender
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Air Bender Maduro

la-flor-dominicana--andalusian-bull.description: Inspired by the toreros of Spain, Andalusian Bull is an unusual salomón with a dark Ecuadorian Corojo wrapper over some of the strongest binder and filler grown on La Flor Dominicana's Dominican farm. Complex and spicy with a touch of sweetness, it brings hickory, caramel, pepper and leather in a medium-full to full smoke.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Andalusian Bull
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Andalusian Bull
The Cigar Authority – LFD Andalusian Bull review
He Spoke Style – Andalusian Bull review
Cigar Obsession – La Flor Dominicana Andalusian Bull review

thirds.notes: Caramel or cedar up front, with leather, black cherry and chestnut and a light pepper finish over an oily, chewy smoke.
Black cherry and sweetness grow with little pepper, as leather and earthy notes move forward and a touch of cream appears.
Caramel and cherry linger, cedar and leather balance, and espresso, nuts and black pepper close it out.

la-flor-dominicana--1994.description: Released in 2014 for La Flor Dominicana's twentieth anniversary, 1994 uses tobacco set aside for years from the brand's Dominican farm, finished in a dark, sweet-savoury Mexican San Andrés wrapper. Full in strength, it is leathery and earthy, with nuts, black pepper and notes of dark cherry and raisin on a bold finish.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – 1994
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana 1994
The Cigar Authority – La Flor Dominicana 1994 Conga review
The Cigar Authority – La Flor Dominicana 1994 Aldaba review
Cigar Obsession – La Flor Dominicana 1994 Conga review

thirds.notes: Molasses and chocolate, or a cognac-like note with peanut, over earth and pepper on the retrohale.
Orange peel brightens the sweetness, dark chocolate and oak take the lead, and coffee joins as the pepper eases.
Dark chocolate and espresso with pepper and spice building in the nose, as the earlier sweetness fades.

la-flor-dominicana--coronado.description: Coronado keeps its original recipe of Dominican filler and binder under a sun-grown Nicaraguan Habano wrapper and is known for a layered, complex profile within the La Flor Dominicana range. Medium to full and rich in body, it is nutty throughout, with nutmeg, leather, a graham-cracker sweetness and pepper.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Coronado
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Coronado
Blind Man's Puff – La Flor Dominicana Coronado blind review

thirds.notes: Smoky wood with a strong mineral edge, coffee overtones and an oily pepper at the back of the throat.
The body fills out around charred wood, minerals and light pepper, with salt on the draw and a hint of bitterness.
Tobacco and spice rise as the fruit fades, ending on strong charred wood with cedar and cinnamon.

la-flor-dominicana--la-nox.description: La Nox, Latin for the night, wraps a sweet, nearly black Brazilian maduro leaf around a San Andrés binder and La Flor Dominicana's own Dominican Piloto and Pelo de Oro fillers. Full but smooth, it offers dark cocoa, clove and anise over walnut and cedar; a late-evening cigar, banded with a starry night sky.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – La Nox
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana La Nox
The Cigar Authority – LFD La Nox review
LA Cigar Collective – La Nox by La Flor Dominicana

thirds.notes: Dark chocolate, black coffee and earth with a raisin-like sweetness, licorice, almond and a floral note.
Coffee moves to the front with earth and licorice, cocoa, raisin and charred cedar, and a first touch of mild pepper.
Bitter espresso dominates over dark chocolate, with a faint cherry note and the balance holding to the end.

la-flor-dominicana--reserva-especial.description: Reserva Especial revives the El Jocko blend that first brought La Flor Dominicana attention, with Dominican estate filler and binder under an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper or a Connecticut broadleaf maduro. Medium and fuller than most Connecticuts, the shade version shows cedar, cinnamon, cardamom and white pepper; the broadleaf leans to dark chocolate and molasses.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Reserva Especial
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Reserva Especial
Blind Man's Puff – La Flor Dominicana Reserva Especial Belicoso blind review

thirds.notes: In the shade-wrapped Belicoso, a velvety smoke heavy on cream and cashew, with oak, cinnamon and a light pepper tingle.
Oak and cedar return with cinnamon and a grapefruit note; smoked slowly it stays delicate, faster it turns spicy and leathery.
Smooth and mild, shifting to salted caramel with creamy roasted nuts, oak and cinnamon in balance.

la-flor-dominicana--la-volcada.description: Named after a tango step, a nod to Litto Gomez's upbringing in Uruguay, La Volcada is a Churchill with a dark Mexican San Andrés maduro wrapper, an Ecuadorian Corojo binder and Dominican filler. Full in strength, it is peppery and leathery, with molasses, espresso and licorice running through a long smoke.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – La Volcada
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana La Volcada

la-flor-dominicana--suave.description: Suave is the gentle side of La Flor Dominicana: an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Dominican binder and filler grown on the Gomez family farms. Mild to medium, it is creamy and nutty, with a light touch of the spice and leather typical of the house; suited to newer smokers or a quiet morning.

sources.title: Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Suave

la-flor-dominicana--chapter-1.description: Conceived by Antonio Gomez of the La Flor Dominicana family, Chapter I is a large 6½ x 58 Chisel packed with Dominican ligero, bound in Connecticut broadleaf and wrapped in a dark, oily Brazilian Habano leaf. Full but balanced, it delivers coffee, cedar and leather over a strong base of earth and pepper; an after-dinner cigar.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Chapter I & Capitulo II
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Chapter I

la-flor-dominicana--capitulo-ii.description: The second chapter of Antonio Gomez's series, Capitulo II pairs a heavy charge of Dominican ligero with an oily Nicaraguan Colorado wrapper in the same 6½ x 58 Chisel format. Full in strength, it builds leather, earth and spice with a hint of raisin and ends on a long, woody finish; meant for seasoned smokers.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Chapter I & Capitulo II
Holt's – La Flor Dominicana Capitulo II

la-flor-dominicana--double-claro.description: Double Claro brings back the green candela wrapper in La Flor Dominicana style: an Ecuadorian candela leaf over a Nicaraguan binder and Dominican filler. Unlike the mild candelas of earlier decades, it carries a surprising amount of strength and a flavour profile set apart from the rest of the LFD range.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Double Claro

la-flor-dominicana--solis.description: Solis, from the Latin for sun, is the first blend by Litto Gomez Jr., created with his father Litto and brother Tony. A sun-grown Habano wrapper and a Sumatra binder hold Dominican filler from the family's farm at La Canela. Powerful and lively, it shows bright flavours shaded by a range of spices.

sources.title: La Flor Dominicana – Solis
